title: Hooked on Fishing Bass Charters
specs: Specializes in largemouth bass fishing with artificial lures
Targets areas with highest probability of holding bass on each lake
Operates on Butler Chain of Lakes and Conway Chain of Lakes near Orlando
Non-Florida residents over age 15 need a freshwater fishing license

gap: Maximum group size not explicitly stated
blurb: Guests fish for largemouth bass using artificial lures on several Central Florida lake chains. Trips focus on safe boating, catching fish, learning techniques, and having fun. The captain targets areas with high bass probability using various techniques and lures.
extraNote: No deposit required · Late cancellations not allowed to reschedule trips in your place · All bookings subject to weather; captain may reschedule for safety and enjoyment · R.D Keene Park- 10900 Chase Rd. Windermere, FL 34786
